context: Rewrites createGrid and createIds to build their arrays with Array.from instead of manual push loops.
explanation: Array.from({ length: n }, mapFn) creates a properly-sized array in one pass and initializes every slot through the map function, avoiding the classic new Array(n).fill(0) trap of sharing references for non-primitive values, while being more concise than manual loops with push. Both replacements produce identical output to the originals, just more directly. Good simplification.
